g.text: Counts show which MitoCarta classes contribute to each candidate layer.
Late-stage decline, joint Braak/CERAD pathology, cognition support, and centrality are continuous axes; AGORA support and MitoCarta-derived functional classes annotate rule-based candidate layers.
Integrated Hsp60/10 client evidence defines candidate classes for mechanistic follow-up
